name: Sumac
siboNotes: Sumac is well-tolerated in typical culinary amounts and adds beneficial antioxidants without feeding bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Start with small amounts (1/2 teaspoon) as the tart flavor is concentrated
Store in airtight container away from light to preserve color and potency
Add at end of cooking to preserve bright flavor and color
Mix with salt for a flavorful finishing seasoning
nutritionalHighlights: Contains vitamin C and anti-inflammatory compounds
Provides tannins with potential antimicrobial properties
Very low in calories and sodium
